title: Port auto-increment feature not working after moving to starlette
body:

### Summary

Hello, I noticed that after updated the streamlit version to more than 1.56, the port auto-increment feature stops working when running streamlit app on more than 1 terminal. All processes will be launched at 8501 instead of finding next available port. I assume it is because of the change from tornado to starlette in version 1.57. I tried up to latest version 1.60 and it's still not working. Is it intended as deprecated feature or just a bug?

Port auto increment to find next available port when run a 2nd applicaiton.

### Summary

This is a **regression on Windows** introduced by the Tornado → Starlette/Uvicorn server migration (v1.57). When the default port `8501` is already in use, Streamlit no longer auto-increments to the next free port; instead every process happily binds to `8501`.

**Likely root cause:** The new server pre-binds its own socket in `_bind_socket()` and unconditionally sets `SO_REUSEADDR`:

```271:271:lib/streamlit/web/server/starlette/starlette_server.py
        sock.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
```

On POSIX systems `SO_REUSEADDR` only permits rebinding sockets left in `TIME_WAIT`, but **on Windows it allows two active sockets to bind the exact same address/port simultaneously**. As a result the second `streamlit run` process binds `8501` successfully, `bind()` never raises `EADDRINUSE`, and the port-retry loop in `UvicornServer.start()` (`for attempt in range(MAX_PORT_SEARCH_RETRIES + 1)`, ~lines 354–392) never advances to the next port. The old Tornado server relied on `tornado.netutil.bind_sockets`, which on Windows uses `SO_EXCLUSIVEADDRUSE` (and avoids `SO_REUSEADDR`), so conflicts were detected and auto-increment worked. The Windows-appropriate fix is to use `SO_EXCLUSIVEADDRUSE` instead of `SO_REUSEADDR` on Windows.

This is a bug/regression, not intended deprecation.

### Related Issues

- [#15378 — Running Streamlit with Starlette in Corporate Network](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/15378): Confirmed `type:regression` from the same Starlette/Uvicorn migration affecting the server on Windows (`area:windows`, `area:network`, `area:server`) — closest sibling in nature.
- [#15022 — Intermittent `OSError: [WinError 121]` since upgrading to `v1.57.0`](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/15022): Another confirmed Windows-specific server regression introduced by the 1.57 Starlette/Uvicorn migration, pointing to Windows socket-handling differences in the new server.
- [#9271 — auto-select next available port](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/9271): Directly concerns the port auto-increment / free-port-search feature this issue reports as broken (see also [#9328](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/9328) for specifying the starting port).
